events.title: 리버풀 defeat 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 4–3 in a thrilling game where Robbie Fowler and Stan Collymore both scored twice for the hosts, helping keep 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 in second and boosting 맨체스터 유나이티드's title bid, as well as boosting 리버풀's own slim title hopes.
미들즈브러 move closer to survival and mid-table security with a 3–1 home win against 셰필드 웬즈데이, who are still in a precarious position.
맨체스터 유나이티드 retained their lead in the Premier League with a 3–2 win over City in the Manchester derby at Maine Road, putting the hosts deeper into relegation trouble.

Major League Soccer kicks-off: an overflow crowd of 31,683 packed Spartan Stadium to witness the historic first match. San Jose Clash forward Eric Wynalda scored the league's first goal in a 1–0 victory over D.C. United .

코번트리 시티 defender David Busst sustains a compound leg fracture in the 1-0 Premier League defeat by 맨체스터 유나이티드 at Old Trafford . Busst is expected to be out of action for at least a year and may never be fully fit to play professional football again. United moved closer to the title with 뉴캐슬 유나이티드's 2–1 defeat by 블랙번 로버스. 퀸스 파크 레인저스 kept their survival bid alive by defeating 에버턴 3–1. 볼턴 원더러스 also kept their survival hopes alive by defeating 첼시, 2–1.
37-year-old striker John Aldridge is appointed player-manager of 트랜미어 로버스 , succeeding John King , who steps down as manager after nine years.

마크 휴스 scores his first hat-trick for 첼시 as they defeat 리즈 유나이티드 4–1 at Stamford Bridge . His old club 맨체스터 유나이티드 lose 3–1 at 사우샘프턴 but still have a six-point lead at the top of the Premier League, while the win is a big boost to 사우샘프턴's survival bid.
뉴캐슬 유나이티드 kept their title challenge alive by defeating 애스턴 빌라 1–0, cutting 맨체스터 유나이티드's lead to three points.
The Merseyside derby at Goodison Park ended in a 1–1 draw, with 안드레이 칸첼스키스 scoring for 에버턴 and Robbie Fowler for 리버풀.

맨체스터 유나이티드 and 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 won 1–0 at home (against 리즈 유나이티드 and 사우샘프턴, respectively), keeping Manchester's lead at three points. Roy Keane scores the only goal of the game against 10-man Leeds, whose goalkeeper Mark Beeney is sent off.

선덜랜드 win promotion to the Premier League, ending their five-year absence from the top flight, meaning that the north-East's three top clubs will all be in the top flight for the first time since the 1970s.
England midfielder 폴 개스코인 publicly asks 테리 베너블스 to remain as national team manager.

브라이언 롭슨 agrees to remain as manager of 미들즈브러 until at least the end of the 1999–2000 season, effectively ending speculation that he will take over as the England manager if 테리 베너블스 follows through with his intention to resign this summer.

볼턴 원더러스 are relegated after one season in the Premier League, losing 1–0 at home to 사우샘프턴. Although 퀸스 파크 레인저스 defeat 웨스트햄 유나이티드 3–0, it is too late to save their 13-year tenure in the top flight. 맨체스터 시티 boost their survival bid with a 1–0 win over 애스턴 빌라, as do 코번트리 시티 with a 2–0 win over 윔블던.
A 5–0 home win against 노팅엄 포리스트 moves 맨체스터 유나이티드 closer to their third league title in four seasons.

The Football Association offer 첼시 manager 글렌 호들 the England manager's job. Hoddle, in management since taking over at 스윈던 타운 five years ago, took his first club into the Premier League in 1993 before taking over at 첼시, guiding them to an FA Cup final and a European semi-final. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 defeat Leeds 1–0, with 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 manager 케빈 키건 ranting on live television against his opposite number at 맨체스터 유나이티드, 알렉스 퍼거슨.
